shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && git log -5 --oneline && rg -n \"weather-tool|enum|specs/hal\" src/orchestration/tools specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md && sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/weather-tool.test.ts && sed -n '1,300p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && sed -n '1,200p' .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'wc -l ../round-brief.md && tail -80 ../round-brief.md && git show --stat --oneline HEAD && git show --format=fuller --no-ext-diff HEAD -- src/orchestration/tools/weather-tool.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,220p' example/weather-tool.ts && sed -n '1,220p' tsconfig.json && sed -n '1,220p' jest.config.js && cat package.json && rg -n \"test-imports-its-subject|rootDir|example/\" .eslintrc* eslint* scripts src --glob '"'!node_modules'"'"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "ls src/types && sed -n '1,80p' src/types/index.ts && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/weather-tool.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'rg -n "ToolExecutor" src/types src/index.ts && git diff --check && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/weather-tool.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/weather-example.ts example/weather-tool.ts .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,70p' src/index.ts && rg -n \"export (type )?.*ToolExecutor|type ToolExecutor|interface ToolExecutor\" src && git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'rg -n "specs/.+#[0-9]+|@spec|spec:" src/**/*.test.ts scripts/**/*.test.ts | head -40; ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null || true; test -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs && echo yes || true'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/weather-tool.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/weather-example.ts example/weather-tool.ts .lore/dod.md && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/weather-tool.test.ts && git diff --check && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff -- .lore/dod.md example/weather-tool.ts src/orchestration/tools/weather-tool.test.ts && sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/weather-example.ts && rg -n \"input schema|validation|malformed|ToolRegistry\" CHANGELOG.md | head -20 && git diff --stat"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md example/weather-tool.ts src/orchestration/tools/weather-tool.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/weather-example.ts && git diff --cached --check && git diff --cached --stat && git commit -m "test weather example through source module" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git status --short --branch'
